method: One discarded call and seven measured sequential daily StepBudget calls per size, direct reflection invocation, minimal two-consumer-per-resident fixture, sizes in increasing order in one process
boundary: Component-only .NET timing and current-thread allocation. No Unity, native market, routes, game frames, saves or complete city validation. Construction and completeness assertions excluded; reflection invocation included. JIT state and host noise limit cross-size comparisons. These are observations from the original audit, not performance thresholds.
